style: Authentic 1950s mid-century modern cookbook illustration, in the style of Jim Beard's Party Cookbook, The Fireside Cook Book, and vintage two-color offset lithograph spot art. Hand-drawn black ink linework with lively crosshatching layered over bold flat gouache and screenprint color blocks on warm matte cream paper stock, slight retro print misregistration and subtle dry-brush paper texture. Limited vintage ink palette: vermilion coral-red, warm ochre mustard-gold, deep olive-sage green, and charcoal-black ink on warm cream paper. Stylized, charming 1950s geometric shapes, NOT photorealistic, NOT a photograph, NOT 3D, NOT modern digital vector clipart. Full-bleed edge-to-edge illustration on warm cream paper background: no book pages, no paper borders, no captions, no words, no text, no labels, no signatures anywhere in the image.

prompts.hero: A grand, festive 1950s mid-century editorial cookbook cover illustration (no text, no words, no people): an elegant stylized oval milk-glass platter heaped with halved twice-baked russet potatoes with puffed golden-ochre cheese peaks, specks of vermilion paprika, olive-green chive curls, and dark-red sujuk bits, flanked by tall brass candlesticks with glowing tapers, stylized oak leaves, and a silhouette roast turkey dish on a harvest-gold table runner. Crisp black ink outlines and crosshatching over flat vermilion, ochre, and sage-olive gouache blocks on warm cream background.
prompts.s1: Stylized 1950s spot illustration: a bold black cast-iron skillet over a stylized blue-and-vermilion gas flame, filled with small brick-red sujuk sausage cubes sizzling in coral-orange fat, a charming mid-century wooden spoon stirring it, beside a small cream plate of drained red sausage bits and a bowl of grated red sausage on an olive-green geometric counter.
prompts.s2: Stylized 1950s spot illustration: neat rows of plump russet potatoes speckled with coarse salt crystals on a silver baking sheet, alongside two dramatic stylized heads of garlic with sliced tops sitting on crinkled geometric silver-grey foil squares, drawn with expressive black ink contours and warm ochre and olive-sage gouache fills.
prompts.s3: Stylized 1950s kitchen still-life illustration: a small saucepan bubbling with golden-brown foaming butter beside a tall geometric tin box grater and three stylized wedges of cheese (cream white cheddar, ochre Gruyère, and textured Parmigiano) with three neat grated mounds on a wooden cutting board. Expressive black ink linework and flat gouache color blocks.
prompts.s4: Stylized 1950s editorial spot illustration: a pair of slender mid-century illustrated hands in a striped tea towel holding a baked potato half and scooping fluffy white potato clouds with a bold ink-drawn spoon into a large cream stoneware bowl, with neat rows of empty brown potato boat shells lined up on a tray.
prompts.s5: Stylized 1950s illustrated kitchen scene: a classic hand-crank tinned-steel food mill perched atop a cream stoneware mixing bowl, fine curls of snowy potato cascading down from the perforated bottom as stylized hands turn the wooden-knob crank, with golden roasted garlic cloves on a small saucer nearby.
prompts.s6: Stylized 1950s culinary spot illustration: overhead view of a big cream mixing bowl filled with swirling velvety potato mash dotted with bright olive chives, vermilion sujuk cubes, and grated ochre cheese, stirred by a bold vermilion rubber spatula, surrounded by stylized shapes of a sour cream dish, a foil-wrapped cream cheese block, a butter bowl, and a glass cream pitcher.
prompts.s7: Stylized 1950s cookbook illustration: a parchment-lined baking pan holding potato boat shells piled high with swirling clouds of cheesy potato filling, topped with generous sprinkles of ochre and cream grated cheese beside small pinch bowls, drawn with crisp black ink crosshatching and flat mid-century color fills.
prompts.s8: Stylized 1950s celebratory spot illustration: a sheet pan of steaming golden-brown bubbling twice-baked potato halves, a hand holding a tiny wire mesh sieve shaking a shower of bright vermilion paprika dust over the tops, with neat little bowls of crispy brick-red sujuk crumbles and bright olive-green chives beside it.
